Finally! I was able to meet my Oshis! Oh, golly me! This game is really good if you are into FNAF-inspired games. And if you are not, well, let me tell ya that these robots are worthy of getting caught for >_O. This is a really well-produced game by Vtubers that wants to demonstrate to the world their value, and I can tell they're achieving it. All the art, and I mean ALL OF IT, is worth the purchase, and the dedication behind it is easily noticeable. From the models to the achievements. The mechanics, though pretty fnaf-like, have a fun twist that probably people who are used to this genre are not prepared for. 4Evil Truly, the developers know how to make a fun spin out of the genre, very ingenious, if you ask me. Storywise is quite fun, simple, and clean. Also, for the deep-bone fans of Vtubers there are a lot of eastereggs. I hope you can catch them all. Music is fitting for a horror game, but at the same time, it also has a hint of cheerfulness. Also, ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥, what is with that phone guy... That voice... makes me want to join a cult or something. SHEESH TL:DR Love it, is super fun and a demonstration of how individuals can come together and make a good product for their fans and push their limits to the best in all possible aspects. I am a big fan of Vchiban and all the amazing talents behind this game. I can't wait to see more games made by Vchiban and/or other Vtubers.

And I'm fairly certain Candii thinks I've done something wrong and is going to punish me in the bad way. Look. It's not like breaking into a place is illegal or anything why do you care so much! I was not expecting to be as addicted to this game as I was. I love the additional gameplay with the printer (even though it can be frustrating when also keeping up with the oshis) and the designs are very, very cute. There are a few issues I've noticed with pulling up the printer and cameras (having to drag your mouse up and down to view the cameras and for the printer, I have to move my mouse all the way to the right and down to access the printer), but the issues are very minor. I think it'd be easier if the tabs were there and you could click on them, but again, very minor and just a preference. Even if you're unfamiliar with VchiBan, I'd recommend this game since it is made with much love and it's a fun spin on the formula!

Its a vtuber fnaf like game that has a lot of potential but it is WAY too rng dependent. Night 3 felt like i had no power cause rosedoodle would consistently show up, and just sit there from like 1 to 5, meanwhile the printer was constantly breaking so i wasnt actually making any progress throughout the night. However when i finally beat it, rosedoodle didn't show up at all, Shiabun showed up once, and buffpup showed up twice, conveniently during both times the printer broke so i had 30% power left compared to running out 75% of the way through the night. The games somehow more rng reliant than fnaf 2, while only having 5 rng reliant things compared to the 9 that stopped you from winding up the box. not to mention how bad the printer breaks is random too, sometimes its as simple as changing 1-3 fuses, sometimes its flipping 1 breaker, sometimes its all of them, sometimes you have to raise/lower a number down to a different number which can be anywhere from like 50 to 500 out (getting a single bad one on this module can be the end of a run too because it takes FOREVER if its over 100 out), Sometimes you just have to hit the glowing buttons, but when you hit them theres a chance for another button to start glowing (i think 3 was the least, but my highest im like 90% sure is in the double digits. doesnt take too long regardless), and sometimes you have to replace the ink carts. 1-4 ink carts could need to be replaced AND your not guaranteed to pull them out the first time you click on them. i have had to click the same cart 5 times before, and each failure plays a little animation before you can attempt again, wasting even more precious time. If they ever patch the game to make it more consistent i would definitely recommend, but as of right now the difficulty in the nights can vary so much that its just frustrating, especially since a good rng run can go bad if the printer decides it doesnt want to work and breaks on repeat near the end. Edit: it also appears that as of rn, the camera's glitch out occasionally and wont let you open them for a bit. it could be intended game design but its so inconsistent that I have no clue what it could be tied too. i found that looking straight ahead and stopping for a bit tends to allow you to open them again but its still strange that most of the time you can open it when looking far left or fair right just fine, but you can't other times.

Beat the whole game in just over 4 hours (minus the Custom Night's 5/20 Mode, may or may not go for that if I am up for it), and honestly... the game is just not very good, namely in the gameplay. There is simply no balancing or filters for things that would absolutely RUIN a run during harder nights, the only thing being camera usage stalling certain characters and slowing others down, but that does not suffice for better gameplay since the way you pull it off is EXTREMELY boring. The mechanics across the board honestly need heavy reworks overall, because what is here honestly could be good, and make for a great gameplay set-up, and with some tweaks, which can be rather small, the game could be a really nice treat. You could give the cameras a direct use to deter characters and keep them away from the office entirely (not the stalling), or maybe using the door lights to make a character go away, even making the printer more comfortable to work with and still keep the proper challenge, stuff like that would make this game a lot more flexible in gameplay design and you can even make unique gameplay loops with some changes. Finally travelling away from the hefty gameplay gripes, I can say the visual styles throughout the game are quite nice and do not look too bad when comparing it to FNaF fan games. :) As much as I do not like giving critique on things, and I do not like saying it, I would not recommend the game. If you want something to do for fun with no intent on fully completing it, go right ahead and do whatever. :D However, if you are looking for a good FNaF-like game and intend on completing the game, I would say it is not worth the time if you want a fun gameplay experience. I certainly do not hate the game at all, but there is a lot left to be desired for it.

Came here for a FNAF inspired game and got one. I love seeing different mechanics and ways other developers add micro managing into a tense situation. It is doable for achievements and personal success. I am pretty sure max mode is not possible because the printer is and always will be the most unfair part of this game. Still the personal success from completing Goober Night is worth the price. Also, remember if you are going for all achievements to get them on your first go around, there isn't a way to go back nights unless you reset your save.

A decent game made by Amazing people. The game has a pretty big issue with RNG, some nights almost nothing happens, some nights are impossible because of the constant assault of creepy cute animations. Most night the girls & Shia are just aggressive enough too make you run out of power just before the printer is done, mostly because Buff constantly makes you shut it off. But i see this as more of a challenge than anything. Its definitely playable you just need equal parts skill and luck.

This is vtuber fnaf, more specifically the VchiBan vtubers in animatronic form. This was and will be my only experience with a FNAF-inspired game. I don't understand why yall love these games, they're not scary. Being timed, and being force into a state of hyper-force only to have a thing yell in my face just pisses me off, not scare me. The time this game genuine surprised me was when the AICANDII animatronic got me when I was fixing the printer with both shutters closed. Talking about AICANDII animatronic, it has a like 5% chance to show up on the left side and you're screwed. Like I said, I had both the shutters closed and still got got, she left and I open the door to only be imminently killed a sec later. My other problem is the printer itself. The printer on nights 4-5 are run killers with ether too many breakdown happening in rapid fire (I got six breakdowns in a row with a huge number diffence as one and just let the run die at that point). Or there is a problem of matching two number between 1-999, and if you get something like 945 and 15, you're just done for. Nights 1-3 are fine cause they slowly introduce each mechanics, mechanics based on RNG. But once you get to Nights 4-5, all the RNGs comes together into one RNG hell. Also the animatronics need a max time they can be outside the windows, cause they can stay forever and ruin the run just by running the battery for two minutes.

A cool FNAF-inspired game. The only thing that makes the game bad is the RNG based systems, on night 4 and 5, you basically have to pray that RNG is on your side else you'll have to be closing the doors constantly, not to mention the printer breaking all the time, and that one block on the printer where you can get the error of needing to go from like a 20 to 900. Other than that cool game.
[Speculative] A 'Five Nights at Freddy's'-esque Game where you monitor multiple cameras, resolve sporadic tech issues, and manage your finite power while being hunted by 4 animatronics (2 Anthro-y?).
Tickets for a convention are sold out, so you sneak in 5 days before, in the hopes of finding one. High quality FNAF fangame, with original elements. The animatronics are inspired by real VTubers.
(VchiBan / Official / Horror / 2024) FNAF-inspired horror game based around the 4 VchiBan members. CONTAINS: Buffpup, AiCandii, rosedoodle & ShiaBun.
